quote: I took coachings with Jasmin Solfaghari on several different occasions, both for audition preparation as well as the preparation and studying of a role. She not only helped me perfect my German, she also helped me get to know the character in depth, so when I went into rehearsals I felt fully prepared.
author: Karen Van Der Walt

quote: I cannot thank Jasmin enough for all of the amazing work we did this summer. Jasmin was so supportive and encouraging of me while still pushing me to be perfect in the language and try new things dramatically. It was truly a privilege to work with her.
author: Brendan Tuohy

quote: Working with Jasmin has brought a whole new understanding to the interpretation of my music. She's given me the tools to be a competitive and confident singer.
author: Mary Osborne
